modules.title: API Documentation Essentials
modules.summary: Comprehensive API documentation including authentication, endpoints, and examples drives adoption and ease of use.

modules.title: API Rate Limiting Implementation
modules.summary: Rate limiting protects APIs from abuse and ensures fair usage via algorithms and response headers.

modules.title: API Versioning Strategies
modules.summary: API versioning enables backward-compatible changes using URL paths, headers, or query parameters.

modules.title: HTTP Status Codes Usage
modules.summary: Proper HTTP status codes inform clients about the result of their requests, distinguishing success, client error, and server error.

modules.title: RESTful API Core Principles
modules.summary: REST (Representational State Transfer) is an architectural style with key constraints like statelessness and uniform interface.

modules.title: Blue-Green Deployment
modules.summary: Reduce downtime by running two identical environments and switching traffic after testing.

modules.title: CI/CD Pipeline
modules.summary: Automated stages from code commit to production deployment for reliable software delivery.

modules.title: Docker Containerization
modules.summary: Package applications with dependencies into portable containers for consistent environments.

modules.title: Kubernetes Deployment
modules.summary: Orchestrate containerized applications at scale using pods, deployments, and services.

modules.title: Monitoring and Logging
modules.summary: Observability practices for production systems, tracking key metrics and using specialized tools.

modules.title: Database Connection Pooling
modules.summary: Maintaining a reusable pool of database connections to reduce overhead and improve performance.

modules.title: Database Migrations
modules.summary: Version-controlled schema changes applied incrementally to keep database schemas in sync.

modules.title: Query Optimization
modules.summary: Analyzing and improving SQL queries for better database performance.

modules.title: Transaction Management
modules.summary: Ensuring data consistency by grouping operations into atomic units with ACID properties and isolation levels.

modules.title: Retrieval Evaluation Rubric Overview
modules.summary: Defines a live test for the knowledge-manager MCP server retrieval using fresh Claude Code sessions and five scenarios.

modules.title: Overall Pass Criteria Summary
modules.summary: A collection of what 'good' looks like across all five scenarios: correct module loading and no fabricated content from unrelated modules.

modules.title: Retrieval Scoring Algorithm
modules.summary: Describes the word-boundary regex scoring used by search_modules to rank candidate modules.

modules.title: Scenario 1: JWT Tokens Direct Hit
modules.summary: Tests retrieval when the query directly matches the module id auth/jwt-tokens.

modules.title: Scenario 2: OAuth Flow Direct Hit
modules.summary: Tests retrieval for the OAuth 2.0 server-side callback flow using the knowledge base.

modules.title: Scenario 3: Connection Pool Direct Hit
modules.summary: Tests retrieval of Postgres connection pool sizing guidance from the database/connection-pool module.

modules.title: Scenario 4: Indirect Cross-Content Match
modules.summary: Tests retrieval when the relevant information is in the caveats field of a module, not in its title or summary.

modules.title: Scenario 5: Out-of-Scope Abstention
modules.summary: Tests that Claude does not hallucinate an answer by loading an unrelated module for an out-of-scope question about Kubernetes ingress.

modules.title: Access Token Usage for API Requests
modules.summary: The access token is used to make API requests on behalf of the user.

modules.title: Authorization Code Flow
modules.summary: The authorization code flow is an OAuth 2.0 grant type where the user authorizes the app, and an authorization code is exchanged for an access token.

modules.title: Authorization Code Return
modules.summary: The provider redirects back to the client with an authorization code after permission is granted.

modules.title: OAuth 2.0 Authorization Framework
modules.summary: OAuth 2.0 is a framework for authorization, enabling third-party applications to obtain limited access to a user's resources.

modules.title: Redirect to Authorization Endpoint
modules.summary: The user is redirected to the provider's authorization endpoint to start the permission process.

modules.title: Token Exchange for Access Token
modules.summary: The client exchanges the authorization code for an access token at the provider's token endpoint.

modules.title: User Login Initiation
modules.summary: The user starts the OAuth flow by clicking a 'Login with Provider' button in the client application.

modules.title: User Permission Grant
modules.summary: The user grants permission to the application at the authorization server's consent screen.
